title: Ordinary supported coefficient tensor square for the second open product
statement: For f:X→S, g:Y→S, closed immersions b:B→X and d:D→Y, an open V of Y, and arbitrary A-modules M,N, the ordinary coefficient tensor square for h:X×S V→X×S Y commutes. The product map is the ordinary support-restriction mate [lem-pur-supported-coefficient-open-mate-quotient], the first-factor map is the uncut projection-composition comparison, and the second-factor map is the inverse image of the cut mate followed by the projection-square comparison. It uses the tensor comparison [def-pur-supported-exterior-product] and canonical pullback comparisons [def-pur-supported-localization-comparisons].

source.place: Tag 0F1E; ordinary coefficient normalization and signed totalization in step 11 of lem-pur-supported-product-localization.

proof.text: The product mate and cut second-factor mate preserve their constant quotients by [lem-pur-supported-coefficient-open-mate-quotient]. Naturality of the projection square and composition compatibility of constant inverse image prove the projected quotient equalities. The uncut first projection follows from the composition identity alone.
Apply [lem-pur-supported-coefficient-tensor-quotient-square] to the three normalized coefficient maps.

theorem supportedCoefficientTensor_ordinaryOpenSecond
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {S X Y B D : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) (b : B ⟶ X) (d : D ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion b] [IsClosedImmersion d] (V : Y.Opens)
    (M N : ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) :
    (supportCoefficientMate
        (supportedCoefficientAdjunction A (supportedProductImmersion f g b d))
        (supportedCoefficientAdjunction A
          (supportedProductImmersion f (V.ι ≫ g) b (supportOnOpen d V)))
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (supportedSecondOpenMap f g V))
        (supportTransport A (supportedSecondOpenMap f g V)
          (supportedProductImmersion f g b d)
          (supportedProductImmersion f (V.ι ≫ g) b (supportOnOpen d V))
          (supportedSecondOpenSupport_complement f g b d V))).app (M ⊗ N) ≫
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (supportedSecondOpenMap f g V)).map
        (supportedCoefficientTensor A f g b d M N) ≫
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (supportedSecondOpenMap f g V))
        ((supportedFirstCoefficients A f g b).obj M)
        ((supportedSecondCoefficients A f g d).obj N) =
    supportedCoefficientTensor A f (V.ι ≫ g) b (supportOnOpen d V) M N ≫
      ((supportSecondOrdinaryOpenFirstCoefficientNatTrans A f g b V).app M ⊗ₘ
        (supportSecondOrdinaryOpenCoefficientNatTrans A f g d V).app N)
